newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS GET BACK TO WINNING WAYS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS GET BACK TO WINNING WAYS.

text.p: South Africa bounced back from their first tour defeat at the weekend with five tries in a 36-20 victory over a French Southeast selection on Tuesday.
Fly-half Franco Smith converted four of the tries and a penalty in a much better kicking performance than Saturday's at Brive when the Springboks lost to the French Barbarians.
South Africa, who meet France in the first test in Bordeaux on Saturday, won all four matches on the Argentine leg of their three-country tour.
Forwards Marius Hurter, Hannes Strydom and Krynauw Otto scored three of the world champions' tries as the Springbok pack dominated play in cold and windy conditions.
Full-back Justin Swart and wing Breyton Paulse also ran in tries for what is effectively the reserve South African side.
Wing Laurent Laflamand and centre Eric Artiguste replied for the home team, whose fly-half Benoit Bellot converted both and also slotted home two penalties.
"A second defeat would have have been disastrous," said South African assistant trainer Nick Mallet. "We had to react and we did so in style. It's a good sign for the next games."

The Southeast team's captain and scrum-half Aubin Hueber, a France international, said: "We saw the full force and effectiveness of their lineouts and rolling maul. That's about all they know how to do but they do it well."
After conceding an early penalty, South Africa dominated the first half territorially but stout French defence allowed them only prop Hurter's try to lead 7-3 at the interval.
South African pressure was too much after Bellot's second penalty had closed the score to 7-6 and three more tries gave the Springboks a 26-6 lead.
The French then pulled back to within six points with their two converted tries before the world champions added another 10 points, including their final try by wing Breyton Paulse.

South Africa - 15-Justin Swart; 14-Joe Gillingham, 13-Jeremy Thomson, 12-Dick Muir, 11-Breyton Paulse (17-Andre Snyman 74); 10-Franco Smith, 9-Kevin Putt; 8-Johan Erasmus, 7-Theo Oosthuizen, 6-Wayne Fyvie (captain), 5-Krynauw Otto, 4-Hannes Strydom, 3-Marius Hurter, 2-Henry Tromp, 1-Toks van der Linde.

Southeast - 15-Nicolas Nadau; 14-Laurent Leflamand, 13-Christophe Lamaison, 12-Eric Artiguste, 11-Christophe Dominici; 10-Benoit Bellot, 9-Aubin Hueber (captain); 8-Pierre Raschi, 7-Alexandre Chazalet, 6-Olivier Magne, 5-Jean Daude, 4-Gerald Orsoni, 3-Richard Crespy, 2-Frederic Grange (20-Fabrice Landreau 41), 1-Laurent Toussaint.
